proposals.evidence: Turner13952 gives Nepali/Maithili/Bhojpuri hāṛ bone and regional haḍḍī bone, including Hindi and northwestern comparanda. The long-vowel singleton and short-vowel geminate source forms belong to this bone family. Preserve the source dental diacritics and plain r; the entry’s proposed deeper connection with asthi is explicitly doubtful. Existing Done/East classification and broad Danuwar dialect-mapping uncertainty remain unchanged.
